head_commit.message:
codex-rs: fix thread resume rejoin semantics (#11756)

## Summary
- always rejoin an in-memory running thread on `thread/resume`, even
when overrides are present
- reject `thread/resume` when `history` is provided for a running thread
- reject `thread/resume` when `path` mismatches the running thread
rollout path
- warn (but do not fail) on override mismatches for running threads
- add more `thread_resume` integration tests and fixes; including
restart-based resume-with-overrides coverage

## Validation
- `just fmt`
- `cargo test -p codex-app-server --test all thread_resume`
- manual test with app-server-test-client
https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/11755
- manual test both stdio and websocket in app

head_commit.message:
fix(linux-sandbox): harden proxy netns setup across CI environments

Restore managed proxy network unsharing to bubblewrap, make vendored loopback netlink setup non-fatal, and harden bridge-side loopback recovery by configuring IFF_UP and 127.0.0.1 when bind retries are needed. This addresses environment-specific RTM_NEWADDR/RTM_NEWLINK failures while avoiding inner-stage CLONE_NEWNET permission failures.

head_commit.message:
bazel: enforce MODULE.bazel.lock sync with Cargo.lock

Add a shared lockfile check script that verifies lockfile freshness with
`bazel mod deps --lockfile_mode=error` so stale `MODULE.bazel.lock`
fails fast without mutating files.

Wire local commands for explicit lockfile workflows:
- `just bazel-lock-update` uses `--lockfile_mode=update`
- `just bazel-lock-check` runs the non-mutating verify script

Run the same check in Bazel CI on one Linux job so lockfile drift is
caught consistently. Document the expected dependency-update flow in
`codex-rs/docs/bazel.md` and add matching guidance in `AGENTS.md`.

Refresh `MODULE.bazel.lock` to match current Cargo resolution.
